page.overview:
Who is Ashwood Stranger?

Ashwood Stranger is a highly-skilled, wandering gunfighter native to the Hive World of Necromunda who takes on causes, sometimes for a fee, sometimes for free, that he believes will bring justice in a gravely unjust world.

Necromunda is a world of unrighted wrongs and lost causes, a world of extreme corruption and abuse where the powerless have no recourse. Yet a lone legend wanders between the hive cities, a ragged gunfighter who walks in justice -- and that is Ashwood Stranger.

The underhives of Necromunda have no shortage of loners, criminals and exiles, many wandering from settlement to settlement trying to keep a low profile or keep to themselves as they make a living. The hooded gunfighter known as Ashwood, or more commonly as simply the "Stranger," is one such fighter. Where Ashwood came from or what he is looking for remains a mystery, the Nomad Blade he wears on his back hinting at his long travels between the hive cities.

Wherever he comes from, however, the gunfighter does have a habit of turning up wherever the Palanite Enforcers are making their presence known. Quite unlike most of his peers, Ashwood is a force for justice within the underhive, often settling debts or righting wrongs, especially when the wrong party is powerless to settle them themselves. Sometimes the Stranger even has followers, though these are just as mysterious as their boss, and like to cover their faces and seldom speak.
